summary: Alert mails are fewer and more useful, and PIM Manager runs with fewer database rights.

fixes.title: Alert mails point to the fix
fixes.text: An alert mail now names the error code with a link to its page. Licence gaps, throttling and problems already fixed no longer send an alert mail.

fixes.title: Long quiet steps are not called stopped
fixes.text: A long step that reports nothing for a while is no longer mistaken for a stopped run.

fixes.title: Fewer database rights needed
fixes.text: The engine and the portal run with fewer database rights.
